_comment: Copy to config.json (kit root or host/) and edit; config.json is git-ignored. Every key is optional; command-line flags win. profile: pinball (PinUP Popper) or arcade (Batocera, RetroBat, RetroPie, ES-DE). cabinet/subtitle override the idle file. idle_config/keypad_config/default_card: file names in cards/ (or paths). port: COM5, /dev/ttyUSB0 or a list; omit to auto-detect. watch_processes: programs that open the keypad while running (omit to use the keypad file's list, [] for none). key_backend: auto | sendinput | evdev | uinput | dry-run. key_hold_ms: how long keypad keys are held (default 40).
subtitle: ARCADE CLASSICS
